notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35075316/0be69842fd692816e1cd1ed367de172bf20875b5.jpg[/img]

* New item - Nova. It causes a explosion that hit nearby enemies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35075316/5158a909c3b86f0fdac1c8c7cddf08c11c91a523.jpg[/img]

* New game mode - Surrounded.
It's a simple but hard mode, based on classic enemy waves.
